name: Twin in green
source:
This young man and his twin brother are Pukis, a subspecies of the Dragon family. They're both business owners. They're looking for fun, however, they are picky about the kind of fun they want.

Agency assessment: this domesticated species has a long history of coexisting with humans, making it a perfect choice for candidates who lead busy lives. However, these two pukis have requested to be submited together. Refrain from toying with their hat and gloves under any circumstances.

[From [url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/whats-your-name]itch.io[/url]]
